releases.title: HA and Container First-start Fixes
releases.summary: SHOW CLUSTER answers on followers and with no leader, a lost database gets a clear error, and HA first starts are faster.
highlights: SHOW CLUSTER answers on followers and on nodes with no leader
A lost nextsql.db now gets an error that names the missing file
HA first starts write one less copy of the database per joining node

changes.text: SHOW CLUSTER, system.replication, system.raft and system.replica_health answer on followers and with no leader, in every read-consistency mode.
nextsql init, nextsql setup and the container's first start name the missing file when a deployment has lost nextsql.db. They still refuse to create a new database.
A container's first start replaces a nextsql.conf left by an earlier first start that did not finish.
Joining HA containers restore onto the data volume, which removes one full copy of the database per joining node.

releases.title: Container First-start Fix
releases.summary: A fresh container now creates its database and starts, and restore and verify work under any UID in the image.
highlights: A fresh container now creates a database and starts
NEXTSQL_DATABASE names the database on first start
nextsql restore and verify work under any UID in the image

changes.text: The image's first start now creates a database, so a fresh container starts and the HA seed backup has data to copy.
NEXTSQL_DATABASE names the database a container creates on first start. It defaults to default.
/tmp in the image is writable by every UID, so nextsql restore and verify no longer fail under a non-default UID.

releases.title: Data-integrity Fix for Page Reuse
releases.summary: Fixes a rollback bug that could reissue live pages and silently overwrite them, and adds nextsql check-pages to detect existing damage.
highlights: Rollback no longer puts pages still in use back on the page freelist
nextsql check-pages detects page ownership damage from earlier releases
nextsqld refuses to start if a live page is on the freelist
The idle task runtime no longer writes to the WAL on every poll

changes.text: A rollback could reissue live pages, causing page already cached errors or silently replacing a live page with an empty one.
Add nextsql check-pages, an offline check for page ownership damage and broken B+Tree structure.
nextsqld refuses to start if a live page is on the freelist, and lifecycle upgrade fails on any page ownership damage.
The idle task runtime no longer writes to the WAL on every poll.
A rolled-back CREATE TABLE or CREATE INDEX no longer leaks the new tree's pages.

releases.title: Performance, Driver Parity, and Tooling
releases.summary: Introduces B+Tree index min/max scan optimizations, administrative KILL SESSION, CLI stdin piping and CSV output, client-side statement caching for all official drivers, Studio workspace improvements, and repository Git standards.
highlights: Index MIN/MAX scans seek directly to leaf extrema on indexed columns without full index scans
Administrative KILL SESSION statement terminates TCP sockets, aborts transactions, and frees locks immediately
CLI standard input piping, RFC 4180 CSV export, execution timer, table formatting, and expanded record inspector
Client-side prepared statement LRU caching across Python, PHP, and Ruby drivers with automatic server handle closure
Standardized .gitattributes, .editorconfig, upgraded Makefile, dev doctor, and fast CI quality workflows

changes.text: Optimize MIN(col) and MAX(col) into direct index leaf seeks on indexed columns.
Administrative KILL SESSION '<id>' statement to abort running transactions, release locks, and terminate TCP connections.
CLI standard input piping (nextsql exec - < script.sql), RFC 4180 CSV output, query timer, and ASCII table views.
Client-side prepared statement LRU caching for Python, PHP, and Ruby drivers with automatic server handle eviction.
Query tab inline renaming, tab duplication with localStorage draft persistence, and 1-click EXPLAIN JSON plan export in Studio.
Standardized Git setup (.gitattributes, .editorconfig, .gitignore), upgraded Makefile with self-documenting help, scripts/dev-doctor.sh, and quality CI.

releases.title: Security and Studio updates
releases.summary: Fixes malformed date-function calls that could terminate the daemon; adds session panic containment, compiler/dependency security updates, and automatic native SQL completion in Studio.
highlights: Wrong date-function arity returns invalid_argument; unexpected session panics close the affected connection and run cleanup
Patched Go toolchains, docs dependencies, and SQL-reference extraction
Consistent Admin presentation and automatic native SQL completion with capability-aware feature notes

changes.text: Validate exact arity for EXTRACT, DATE_TRUNC, DATE_ADD, and DATE_DIFF before indexing or NULL propagation.
Contain recoverable serving-goroutine panics, close the affected connection, and run transaction/session cleanup without logging panic payloads.
Require Go 1.26.10 for native builds, use Go 1.27.3 for containers, and patch docs dependencies and the SQL-reference generator regex.
Use consistent Admin components across Setup, Operations, and Studio.
Open native SQL completion automatically in Studio and annotate feature availability from the connected server.
Correct the Node TypeScript smoke-test configuration; Node and Bun runtime packages remain unchanged at 0.0.1.

releases.title: First public preview
releases.summary: The first public release of NextSQL: one encrypted ACID engine for SQL, JSON, vectors, full-text, and geo, with official drivers at 0.0.1.
highlights: One WAL, one MVCC, and one optimizer for SQL, JSON, vectors, full-text, and geo
AES-256-GCM envelope encryption and group-commit WAL with page-delta redo
Official Go, Node, Bun, PHP, Python, and Ruby drivers at 0.0.1

changes.text: Clustered B+Tree storage, group-commit WAL, and fsync before commit is acknowledged.
Hybrid SELECT: filters, SEARCH (BM25), and NEAREST (ANN) in one physical plan with reciprocal rank fusion.
Native JSON columns (NSJB) with path extract and path indexes.
VECTOR<F32,N> with flat and HNSW indexes.
Inverted full-text index, BM25 ranking, and phrase queries.
WGS84 POINT, BOX, LINESTRING, and POLYGON, plus GEOMETRY and GEOGRAPHY.
Envelope encryption, TLS 1.3 off loopback, password auth, and RBAC.
Three-voter Raft, quorum commits, and encrypted replication.
nextsql init/setup/exec/migrate and nextsqld with --key-file off the data volume.
Official Go, Node, Bun, PHP, Python, and Ruby drivers at 0.0.1 (npm @bzync/nextsql, Composer bzync/nextsql, PyPI/RubyGems bzync-nextsql). Keys never go in a URL.
Page-delta WAL redo: a commit logs only the bytes that changed, about 8× less disk writing per insert, without weakening fsync.
Native Windows packages are not shipped. On Windows, run the Linux packages inside WSL 2.
